decisions.reason: The vertigo combination tablet sits close to the firm's established prescription and formulation know-how, has its own product page, and the firm's in-house R&D lets it read early results and refine the product.

The generic antidepressant is distant from the firm's established offer, which limits how well it can interpret early results, but in-house R&D, contract-manufacturing capabilities and a dedicated product page give enough related knowledge to keep it for now.

The combination antihypertensive builds closely on the firm's existing formulation and film-tablet expertise and fits its strategy of improved, adherence-supporting combinations, so it is well positioned to absorb learning.

The bone and joint supplement builds on the firm's established self-care and supplement range and supports its pharmacy-exclusive strategy, though its only brief mention on the website suggests lower priority.
